question: What conflicts are identified between regulations?
cypher: MATCH (ra:Regulation)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(c1:Clause)<-[:HAS_CLAUSE]-(rb:Regulation) WHERE ra.regulationId < rb.regulationId AND EXISTS((c1)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(sd:SubDomain)) WITH ra, rb, c1, sd MATCH (c2:Clause)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(sd) WHERE c2.regulationId <> c1.regulationId AND c2.regulationId <> ra.regulationId AND c2.regulationId <> rb.regulationId RETURN ra.regulationId AS reg1, rb.regulationId AS reg2, sd.subDomainId, c1.clauseId AS clause1, c2.clauseId AS clause2, c1.obligationType AS type1, c2.obligationType AS type2, c1.normativeIntensity AS intensity1, c2.normativeIntensity AS intensity2, CASE WHEN c1.obligatedParty <> c2.obligatedParty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS partyConflict, CASE WHEN c1.normativeIntensity <> c2.normativeIntensity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intensityConflict, CASE WHEN c1.obligationType <> c2.obligationType THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS typeConflict ORDER BY reg1, reg2, sd.subDomainId LIMIT 50;
